answer_text: To reset Mark's MFA, in the Cato Management Application go to Access > Users, check the box next to Mark’s user entry, and choose Reset MFA from the Actions menu, then confirm. He will receive an email with a link to the Cato User Portal; after signing in, he’ll be prompted to re-enroll MFA. This action resets his MFA so he can set it up again on a new device.
